title: Supplier payables
intro: Review documents, installments and cash linked to suppliers.
coverage: This query and export cover only loaded documents for this company, store and device. They do not represent the entire financial position.
readonly: Read only. Writes require cash permissions and the required modules.
aboutText: Cash payments link existing audited withdrawals. Returns link existing cash supplies. No drawer movement is created twice.
external: The balance includes cash recorded here. It does not confirm external payment, supplier receipt, Pix, card or a fiscal document.
future: Document creation, approval, corrections and assisted movement selection still require complete contract integration.
denied: You do not have permission for this operation.
unavailable: Service or record unavailable. Check the server version.
conflict: Data or state changed. Review the record before retrying.
failed: Unable to complete. Check the result before retrying.
invalid: The response or fields do not match the expected format.
connection: Unable to confirm communication with the server.
retryHelp: The result is unconfirmed. Look it up or resend the same operation. Do not make another physical payment. Keep this screen open.
noTransfer: This record does not transfer money or prove bank settlement.
range: The start date must be on or before the end date.
cashBasis: Declared cash with audited sources. The balance excludes unknown external payments.
noPayments: No cash payments on this page.
sourceHelp: Use the reference of an existing movement. The server checks actor, source, exclusivity and amount. No amount is entered here.
fullReturn: A return requires a cash supply equal to the full payment. Partial returns are unavailable here.
keyHelp: References: unaccented letters, digits, dots, hyphens, colons or underscores; up to 128 characters.
confirm: I checked the document and physical movement. Record this link without moving money again.
recorded: The server confirmed the record. Review refreshed balances.
notFoundYet: The server did not find a receipt. This does not prove the previous attempt failed. Resend the same operation without creating another.
